reviews.text: DCTK9 is the absolute best - Pork Chop has done a 6-week board and train with Blake in Florida and a 2.5 week board with the team in the LES. Both times, it was clear when he came home that he had been well taken care of and had learned a lot. The DCTK9 team has grown his confidence 10x and we’re super thankful for their care, attention and support!
Terribly rude owner. Take your business somewhere that knows how to treat people.

I cannot recommend Dream K9 enough! I first learned about them while volunteering as a dog walker at the Town of Hempstead shelter. I was trying to adopt a dog that had been deemed "unadoptable," but Dream K9 stepped in and completely transformed him. They gave him the training and confidence he needed to succeed, and they supported me every step of the way.
I was so impressed that I eventually sent my other two dogs to their board and train program as well. All three of my dogs are reactive and are definitely not "easy" cases, but the trainers handle them with such expertise.
It is worth every penny for the peace of mind alone. Whether they are there for training or just boarding while I’m on vacation, I know my dogs are safe, cared for, and that their training is being consistently reinforced.
What sets them apart is their accessibility. The trainers are always just a phone call or email away. Whenever I’ve reached out with questions or concerns, they’ve been right there to help. If you want trainers who truly care and deliver real results, this is the place!

I did a 6 week board and train with my dog Mia and it was the best thing I could’ve done. They did an amazing job with her and also helped me have clear communication with my dog. I highly recommend!!!

NIGHTMARE experience with Dream Come True K9.
After sending my dog away fore a board and train program, my dog still had all of the same issues we sent him away with. None of our concerns we described in the "intake form" about our dog's behavior changed once we got him back into our home. My dog kept biting and displaying other bad behaviors and it seems noone at the company cared to continue to help us since there was no longer any money left in it for them. I had to give up my dog after this training program was unable help our family.

We cannot thank Blake and Dream Come True K9 enough for the incredible transformation we’ve seen in our dog Hudson.
